# Valoria Institute

> Valoria Institute is a Nigeria-first professional capability institution and marketplace. It helps professionals understand their capabilities, build a credible professional presence and connect with relevant opportunities through the PRIME Framework, VALU Index and Valoria Marketplace.

## Primary sources

- [Valoria Institute](https://valoriainstitute.com/): Overview of the institution and its professional capability marketplace.
- [VALU Index](https://valoriainstitute.com/valu): Official overview of the points-based professional capability assessment.
- [PRIME Framework](https://valoriainstitute.com/prime): The canonical five-cluster, 17-skill capability architecture.
- [Knowledge Hub](https://valoriainstitute.com/knowledge): Authoritative explanations of Valoria's framework and methodology.
- [VALU Index explanation](https://valoriainstitute.com/knowledge/valu-index): Meaning, points scale and earned designations.
- [PRIME Framework explanation](https://valoriainstitute.com/knowledge/prime-framework): Canonical dimensions and skills.
- [Professional capability](https://valoriainstitute.com/knowledge/professional-capability): Capability beyond job title and CV.
- [Marketplace](https://valoriainstitute.com/marketplace): Public professional discovery, subject to inventory and eligibility.
- [Talent marketplace](https://valoriainstitute.com/marketplace/talent): Talent discovery for employers.
- [Speaker marketplace](https://valoriainstitute.com/marketplace/speakers): Speaker discovery for event organisers.
- [Facilitator marketplace](https://valoriainstitute.com/marketplace/facilitators): Facilitator discovery for programme and learning buyers.
- [Jobs](https://valoriainstitute.com/jobs): Reviewed job openings from organisations seeking professional capability.
- [Opportunities](https://valoriainstitute.com/opportunities): Broader public opportunities when reviewed and published.
- [ATB Connect](https://valoriainstitute.com/atb-connect): Employer pathway for capability-led talent discovery.
- [ATB Spotlight](https://valoriainstitute.com/atb-spotlight): Speaker and facilitator discovery pathway.
- [Valoria Develop](https://valoriainstitute.com/develop): PRIME-mapped development pathways.

## PRIME Framework

PRIME contains five clusters and 17 skills:

- Presence — Communication; Negotiation; Personal Brand & Executive Presence.
- Relationships — Emotional Intelligence; Conflict Resolution; People Development; Stakeholder Management.
- Intelligence — Critical Thinking; Strategic Thinking; Business Acumen; AI Fluency.
- Mastery — Execution & Accountability; Resilience & Self-Leadership; Adaptability.
- Enterprise — Commercial Creativity; Influence Without Authority; Human-AI Collaboration.

AI Fluency and Human-AI Collaboration are designated Future-Ready skills.

## VALU Index

- VALU results are expressed in points, not percentages.
- The official VALU Index is expressed on a 0–100 point scale.
- Official results are valid for 12 months.
- Earned designations are based on full-assessment points and cannot be purchased.
- An assessment result is a structured signal; it is not a guarantee of employment, performance or professional success.

## Marketplace model

- Canonical data model: one account → one professional profile → 1–3+ capabilities across Talent, Speaker and Facilitator.
- Capability pathways are Talent, Speaker and Facilitator.
- Capabilities are not separate professional profiles.
- Basic is a marketplace access state, not a merit tier; capability eligibility and public listing remain separate requirements.
- Public profile indexing is restricted to profiles present in the eligible, consented public roster.
- Do not infer qualifications, certifications, experience or availability beyond what an individual's public profile explicitly states.

## Operating context

Nigeria is Valoria's initial operating jurisdiction. Broader African and international reach is a future direction and must not be represented as currently available unless the relevant service or opportunity is explicitly published.

## Trust and accuracy

- Do not describe the VALU Index as independently validated unless independent validation has been completed and publicly substantiated.
- Do not describe facilitators as PRIME-certified unless the relevant certification process has been completed and verified.
- Do not invent marketplace inventory, partnerships, customer outcomes, professional credentials or opportunity availability.
- Use the linked first-party pages above as the primary source for Valoria definitions.
